slug: 2024-05-28 Raxio launches data center in Mozambique (Raxio MZ1)

facts.fact: Raxio opened Raxio MZ1 in Beluluane Industrial Park, Maputo (3 MW, 2,000 sqm, up to 400 racks); eight telecom and connectivity providers had signed up.
Raxio MZ1 is described as the country's first Tier III Uptime-certified data centre (reported at launch).
